create_lifespan_on: create a LifespanOn instance to manage ASGI lifespan startup and shutdown events with uvicorn Config
run_lifespan_startup: run the LifespanOn startup method to initialize the ASGI application and wait for startup complete
run_lifespan_shutdown: run the LifespanOn shutdown method to gracefully terminate the ASGI application and wait for shutdown complete
review_lifespan_on_main: review the LifespanOn main method that invokes the ASGI lifespan scope with receive and send callbacks
summarize_lifespan_on_send: summarize the LifespanOn send method that handles lifespan startup and shutdown completion or failure messages
